attackTeams.methodology: Team value = sum over the shipped defender ranking of defender score * (best team answer + 0.5 * second-best team answer), where a member's answer to a defender is its published practical fast+charged pair's cycle DPS at Level 40 / 15 attack IV, with type effectiveness applied PER MOVE against that defender's real dual typing (not a single shorthand type). Members are chosen greedily, one slot at a time, by marginal gain on that objective; premium allows at most one Mega, since only one can be active in a battle party. Does NOT model dodging, weather, friendship, or Party Power. The budget six is not computed against this objective — it is the accessible Build These Six list, unchanged and relabelled, so its coverageGaps and answers are reported for transparency rather than optimized for.

curatedCoverage.note: Editorial notes from data/curated/gym-guidance.json are attached to the rows they describe. They do not decide who is on the list — the ranking is computed over every eligible form — but where a curated row names a moveset, that hand-researched pair is the one shown, because it accounts for dodging and the computed metric does not.

gym.defenderLevelNote: There is no computed optimal level here, and that is deliberate: raising a defender adds bulk but also raises CP, and higher CP loses motivation faster (Niantic's own gym-battles page). Trading those off needs the motivation decay rate, which is not in this app's frozen sources, so a specific 'best level' would be invented. What IS sourced: favour Defense and Stamina IVs over Attack, since Attack IV only inflates CP without adding staying power.

lineupLeads.note: These 3 leads (Blissey, Snorlax, Slaking) are a fixed editorial choice of three genuinely different opening questions, not the 3 computed-best leads by score — a lead's own solo rank can sit far below the lineups it opens (see each lead's whyLead).

lineupPolicy.note: Within each lineup shape, each fixed lead may anchor up to 6 lineups by design (its own appearance cap is exempted — that is the point of per_lead); no OTHER Pokemon anchors more than 2 options there. gym.methodology: Practical delay, weakness diversity, solo reliability, healing cost, and low-resource accessibility; gym defense can delay but cannot guarantee a hold.

gym.rankingMethodology: Computed from frozen sources: bulk (base Defense x Stamina), divided by type-weighted exposure to the best attacker this dataset ranks for each attacking type, scaled by the defender's own best obtainable fast+charged attack cycle (a shadow fights on Frustration, not a Charged TM it may never get — see shadowChargedUpgrade for what a TM would buy). Does not model motivation/CP decay, berries, dodging, or an attacker simply bringing the hard counter. Scores are normalised to the top-ranked defender (Blissey) = 100 — every other score is relative to that one form, not an absolute or percentage figure.

staggerGuide.caveat: Exact spacing is not guaranteed: network lag, lobby grouping, defender Golden Razz Berries, battle errors, and live game changes can merge or invalidate waves. Treat this as coordination guidance, not a promised knockout timer.
staggerGuide.goal: Create separate battle waves against the first defender so its motivation can fall in quick succession and the pair avoids wasting time on the full lineup.

steps.action: Preselect the correct counter team, confirm the first defender, and agree that Player A starts alone. Do not tap Battle together.
Enter and begin the first defender. Call out when the GO screen has cleared and damage is registering.
Enter after A's battle is established so the game is more likely to create a later battle wave. Use the defender HP/state on your own screen, not a rigid stopwatch.
After the win registers, use the exit/back option instead of continuing to defender two, then re-enter the first slot for the next motivation drop.
Finish your wave and also exit rather than advancing. Call the result so A knows whether the defender was berried or removed.
Repeat on the same first defender until removed, then reassess the new first slot. If both players merge into one battle, separate and restart the spacing rather than assuming the stagger worked.
